Amara Okafor

Principal Designer · Linework Studio · Lagos

Tuesday keynote

Amara has spent a decade pulling identity systems apart and reassembling them with fewer moving parts. Her keynote argues for design systems that age well — not the ones that demo well.

The Patient System: Designing for Year Five, Not Launch Week

Tue · 09:30 · Main Hall

Rin Takahashi

Independent Type Designer · Kyoto

Wednesday keynote

Type designer behind Kobun and Plume Mono. Rin will trace the path from a single ink stroke to a 14-weight variable family, including every detour she'd recommend skipping.

A Quiet Argument for Slower Type

Wed · 09:30 · Main Hall

Diego Marín

Staff Engineer · Hearthlight · Mexico City

Thursday keynote

Diego writes about boring frontend infrastructure with surprising affection. Expect a talk about caching, observability, and the joy of deleting code you wrote two years ago.

Boring on Purpose: A Frontend Survival Guide

Founder · Field Notes Co. · Dublin

Friday closing

Saoirse runs a two-person studio with a waitlist longer than most agencies. Her closing talk is about pricing, saying no, and the strange grief of turning down good work.

The Small-Studio Math Nobody Teaches
